---
title: "October 96 well plate"
format: html
---
#import file
```{r}
#make sure you set the folder where your file is saved as the current working directory
#check whether the excel file names are the same and don't change the dataframe name
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
hr_growth <- read_excel("1hr_growth_10.9.26_cleaned.xlsx")

Overnight_withBacteriocin_E2_S4 <- read_excel("10.9_Overnight_withBacteriocin_E2+S4_cleaned.xlsx")
```

#clean and combine
```{r}
Overnight_withBacteriocin_E2_S4$"Cycle Nr." <- as.numeric(Overnight_withBacteriocin_E2_S4$"Cycle Nr.")

hr_growth$"Cycle Nr." <- as.numeric(hr_growth$"Cycle Nr.")
```

```{r}
Overnight_withBacteriocin_E2_S4$"Cycle Nr." <- Overnight_withBacteriocin_E2_S4$"Cycle Nr." + 6
```

```{r}
Overnight_withBacteriocin_E2_S4$"Time [s]" <- Overnight_withBacteriocin_E2_S4$"Time [s]" + 3000.072

```

```{r}
combined_df <- bind_rows(hr_growth, Overnight_withBacteriocin_E2_S4)
```

```{r}
#preserve both cycle nr. and time
pivoted_OD <- pivot_longer(combined_df, cols = -c(1,2), names_to = "well_ID", values_to = "OD")
```

```{r}
df_clean <- na.omit(pivoted_OD)

#df_clean <- df_clean[-c(1, 2), ]

df_clean <- df_clean |> 
  filter(well_ID != "Temp. [°C]")
```

```{r}
#remove useless dataframes if u want
rm(combined_df)
rm(pivoted_OD)
rm(Overnight_withBacteriocin_E2_S4)
rm(hr_growth)
```

#make a key col
```{r}
df_clean<- df_clean |>
   mutate(key = case_when(
      str_detect(well_ID, "E2") ~ "E2",
    str_detect(well_ID,"S4") ~ "S4",
    TRUE ~ "LB"  # default for unmatched values
  ))
```
```{r}
df_clean<- df_clean |>
  mutate(replicate = case_when(
    str_ends(well_ID, "1") ~"1",
    str_ends(well_ID, "2") ~"2",
    str_ends(well_ID, "3") ~"3",
    TRUE ~ NA  # default for unmatched values
  ))
df_clean<- df_clean |>
  mutate(bacteriocin_conc = case_when(
    str_starts(well_ID, "0") ~"0",
    str_starts(well_ID, "2") ~"2",
    str_starts(well_ID, "4") ~"4",
    str_starts(well_ID, "8") ~"8",
    str_starts(well_ID, "10") ~"10",
    str_starts(well_ID, "16") ~"16",
    str_starts(well_ID, "32") ~"32",
    str_starts(well_ID, "48") ~"48",
    str_starts(well_ID, "64") ~"64",
    str_starts(well_ID, "82") ~"82",
    str_starts(well_ID, "100") ~"100",
    TRUE ~ NA  # default for unmatched values
  ))
```
```{r}
df_clean<- df_clean |>
  mutate(trial_ID = paste(key, replicate, sep = "_"),
         conc_ID = paste(key, bacteriocin_conc, sep = "_"))

df_clean[df_clean == "E2_NA"] <- "LB"
df_clean[df_clean == "S4_NA"] <- "LB"

```

#error bar
```{r}
df_summarise<-df_clean |>
  group_by(key, conc_ID, `Time [s]`) |>
  summarise(
    min=min(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    max=max(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean = mean(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(CV = sd/mean)
```


#plot curve
```{r} 
#E2 plot
E2_curve<- df_summarise |>
  filter(key == "E2") |>
ggplot( 
       aes(x = `Time [s]`, y = mean, color = conc_ID)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = min, ymax = max, color = conc_ID), 
                width = 0.2)+
   scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
   labs(title = "Overnight_withBacteriocin_E2")

ggsave("E2_96well_261009.png", plot = E2_curve)

E2_curve_CV<- df_summarise |>
  filter(key == "E2") |>
ggplot( 
       aes(x = `Time [s]`, y = CV, color = conc_ID)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
  labs(title = "Overnight_withBacteriocin_E2_CV")

ggsave("E2_96well_CV_261009.png", plot = E2_curve_CV)

```
